verdict.rationale: Windmill lets ops users write full scripts in TypeScript, Python, Go, SQL, Bash, etc. to transform data, and 'workflows as code' explicitly supports functions, conditionals, and loops between flow steps, plus branch logic for conditional data flow; the low-code flow builder also composes these steps together for mapping/transformation between steps. Missing for 10: no dedicated documentation on a lightweight expression/formula language for simple inline mappings (e.g., JS expression fields) distinct from full scripts, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of transformation ergonomics.
